name: mapnetwork-mcp
description: Generate styled PNG/SVG map images of places in Japan with 11 customizable color themes.
long_description:
MCP server for MapNetwork — turn places in Japan into styled, illustration-like map images (PNG / SVG), directly from Claude.

Maps are built from detailed OpenStreetMap data served by MapNetwork's own Overpass API for Japan, so coverage is currently limited to Japan (country code JP).

- Generate a map from a place name or a list of markers
- Overlay a walking / driving route between two places
- 11 color themes (white, darkBlue, darkGreen, popArt, lightBlue, lightGreen, beige, magenta, gray, black, brown)
- PNG or SVG output, saved to your Downloads folder
- Re-download a previously generated map in a different theme or format without regenerating
- Open any generated map in the MapNetwork web editor for manual customization
- View any generated map in 3D — each result includes a link that draws a 3D rendering of the map in your own desktop browser and shows it as an image (not available on mobile devices)

tools.name: generate_map
tools.description: Generate a styled map image centered on a single place and save it to Downloads

tools.name: generate_markers_map
tools.description: Generate a map with multiple pinned locations

tools.name: generate_route_map
tools.description: Compute a walking or driving route between two places and generate a map with it overlaid

tools.name: download_map
tools.description: Check a pending map generation job and download it once ready

tools.name: redownload_map
tools.description: Re-download a previously generated map in a different color theme or format
